evidence.title: Circle Loaders - twenty-four monochrome agent-status animations

name: Circle Loaders
summary: Twenty-four monochrome circular loading animations, each a standalone animated SVG to copy.
description: A set of 24 circular loader animations drawn from hairlines clipped to a disc, shown small and with tempo/diameter controls. Every variant is a standalone animated SVG - markup, keyframes and colour in one file - copied from its card in light or dark; pure CSS and SVG, no dependencies, no JavaScript, reduced-motion aware.
contains: each loader is a standalone animated SVG file
monochrome, works on light and dark backgrounds
pure CSS and SVG, no dependencies or JavaScript
